import Mathlib

  (a b c : ℝ)
  (h₀ : 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ 0 < c)

  have h₃ : 0 < b + c := by linarith
  have h₄ : 0 < c + a := by linarith
  have h₅ : 0 < Real.sqrt 2 := by positivity
  have h₆ : 0 < Real.sqrt (a + b) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr h₂
  have h₇ : 0 < Real.sqrt (b + c) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr h₃
  have h₈ : 0 < Real.sqrt (c + a) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr h₄
  
  -- Apply Cauchy-Schwarz: (∑ x_i/y_i)² · (∑ x_i·y_i) ≥ (∑ x_i)²
  have h₉ : (a / Real.sqrt (a + b) + b / Real.sqrt (b + c) + c / Real.sqrt (c + a))^2 * 
    (a * (a + b) + b * (b + c) + c * (c + a)) ≥ (a + b + c)^2 := by
    -- Use Cauchy-Schwarz in the form (∑ u_i/v_i)² · (∑ u_i·v_i) ≥ (∑ u_i)²
    have h₉₁ : 0 ≤ a / Real.sqrt (a + b) := by positivity
    have h₉₂ : 0 ≤ b / Real.sqrt (b + c) := by positivity
    have h₉₃ : 0 ≤ c / Real.sqrt (c + a) := by positivity
    have h₉₄ : 0 ≤ a * (a + b) := by nlinarith
    have h₉₅ : 0 ≤ b * (b + c) := by nlinarith
    have h₉₆ : 0 ≤ c * (c + a) := by nlinarith
    
    -- Apply Cauchy-Schwarz: (∑ x_i)² ≤ (∑ x_i²)(∑ 1)
    calc
      (a / Real.sqrt (a + b) + b / Real.sqrt (b + c) + c / Real.sqrt (c + a))^2 * 
        (a * (a + b) + b * (b + c) + c * (c + a)) =
        ((a / Real.sqrt (a + b))^2 + (b / Real.sqrt (b + c))^2 + (c / Real.sqrt (c + a))^2) *
          (a * (a + b) + b * (b + c) + c * (c + a)) := by ring_nf
      _ ≥ (a + b + c)^2 := by
        -- Use Cauchy-Schwarz: (∑ x_i)² ≤ (∑ x_i²)(∑ 1)
        have h₉₇ : 0 ≤ a / Real.sqrt (a + b) := by positivity
        have h₉₈ : 0 ≤ b / Real.sqrt (b + c) := by positivity
        have h₉₉ : 0 ≤ c / Real.sqrt (c + a) := by positivity
        have h₉₁₀ : 0 ≤ a * (a + b) := by nlinarith
        have h₉₁₁ : 0 ≤ b * (b + c) := by nlinarith
        have h₉₁₂ : 0 ≤ c * (c + a) := by nlinarith
        
        -- Apply Cauchy-Schwarz directly
        have h₉₁₃ : (a / Real.sqrt (a + b) + b / Real.sqrt (b + c) + c / Real.sqrt (c + a))^2 ≤
          ((a / Real.sqrt (a + b))^2 + (b / Real.sqrt (b + c))^2 + (c / Real.sqrt (c + a))^2) * 3 := by
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a / Real.sqrt (a + b) - b / Real.sqrt (b + c)),
            sq_nonneg (b / Real.sqrt (b + c) - c / Real.sqrt (c + a)),
            sq_nonneg (c / Real.sqrt (c + a) - a / Real.sqrt (a + b))]
        
        -- Alternative approach using direct Cauchy-Schwarz
        have h₉₁₄ : (a + b + c)^2 ≤ 
          ((a / Real.sqrt (a + b))^2 + (b / Real.sqrt (b + c))^2 + (c / Real.sqrt (c + a))^2) *
          (a * (a + b) + b * (b + c) + c * (c + a)) := by
          -- Use the form (∑ x_i)² ≤ (∑ x_i²)(∑ 1) with appropriate weights
          have h₉₁₅ : 0 < Real.sqrt (a + b) := by positivity
          have h₉₁₆ : 0 < Real.sqrt (b + c) := by positivity
          have h₉₁₇ : 0 < Real.sqrt (c + a) := by positivity
          
          -- Apply Cauchy-Schwarz: (∑ u_i v_i)² ≤ (∑ u_i²)(∑ v_i²)
          have h₉₁₈ : (a + b + c)^2 = (Real.sqrt (a + b) * (a / Real.sqrt (a + b)) + 
            Real.sqrt (b + c) * (b / Real.sqrt (b + c)) + 
            Real.sqrt (c + a) * (c / Real.sqrt (c + a)))^2 := by
            field_simp [h₆, h₇, h₈]
            <;> ring_nf
            <;> field_simp [h₆, h₇, h₈]
            <;> ring_nf
          
          have h₉₁₉ : (Real.sqrt (a + b) * (a / Real.sqrt (a + b)) + 
            Real.sqrt (b + c) * (b / Real.sqrt (b + c)) + 
            Real.sqrt (c + a) * (c / Real.sqrt (c + a)))^2 ≤
            ((Real.sqrt (a + b))^2 + (Real.sqrt (b + c))^2 + (Real.sqrt (c + a))^2) *
              ((a / Real.sqrt (a + b))^2 + (b / Real.sqrt (b + c))^2 + (c / Real.sqrt (c + a))^2) := by
            -- Standard Cauchy-Schwarz
            nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (a + b) * (b / Real.sqrt (b + c)) - Real.sqrt (b + c) * (a / Real.sqrt (a + b))),
              sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (b + c) * (c / Real.sqrt (c + a)) - Real.sqrt (c + a) * (b / Real.sqrt (b + c))),

                ((a / Real.sqrt (a + b))^2 + (b / Real.sqrt (b + c))^2 + (c / Real.sqrt (c + a))^2) := by

            _ = (a + b + b + c + c + a) *
                ((a / Real.sqrt (a + b))^2 + (b / Real.sqrt (b + c))^2 + (c / Real.sqrt (c + a))^2) := by
              simp [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ a + b from by linarith),
                    Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ b + c from by linarith),
                    Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ c + a from by linarith)]
              <;> ring_nf
            _ = (2 * (a + b + c)) *
                ((a / Real.sqrt (a + b))^2 + (b / Real.sqrt (b + c))^2 + (c / Real.sqrt (c + a))^2) := by ring
            _ ≤ ((a / Real.sqrt (a + b))^2 + (b / Real.sqrt (b + c))^2 + (c / Real.sqrt (c + a))^2) *
                (a * (a + b) + b * (b + c) + c * (c + a)) := by
              -- Need to show 2*(a+b+c) ≤ a*(a+b) + b*(b+c) + c*(c+a)
              have h₉₂₀ : 2 * (a + b + c) ≤ a * (a + b) + b * (b + c) + c * (c + a) := by

                  mul_pos h₀.1 h₀.2.1, mul_pos h₀.2.1 h₀.2.2, mul_pos h₀.2.2 h₀.1]
              nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ (a / Real.sqrt (a + b))^2 + (b / Real.sqrt (b + c))^2 + (c / Real.sqrt (c + a))^2 by positivity)]
        
        exact h₉₁₄
  
  -- Now we need to show that (a + b + c)^2 / (a*(a+b) + b*(b+c) + c*(c+a)) ≥ 9/2
  have h₁₀ : (a + b + c)^2 / (a * (a + b) + b * (b + c) + c * (c + a)) ≥ 9 / 2 := by
    -- Use the constraint ab + bc + ca ≥ 3
    have h₁₀₁ : 0 < a * (a + b) + b * (b + c) + c * (c + a) := by
      nlinarith [mul_pos h₀.1 h₀.2.1, mul_pos h₀.2.1 h₀.2.2, mul_pos h₀.2.2 h₀.1]
    
    have h₁₀₂ : (a + b + c)^2 ≥ (9 / 2) * (a * (a + b) + b * (b + c) + c * (c + a)) := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (b - c), sq_nonneg (c - a),
        mul_pos h₀.1 h₀.2.1, mul_pos h₀.2.1 h₀.2.2, mul_pos h₀.2.2 h₀.1,
        sq_nonneg (a + b + c), sq_nonneg (a + b - c), sq_nonneg (b + c - a),
        sq_nonneg (c + a - b)]
    
    have h₁₀₃ : (a + b + c)^2 / (a * (a + b) + b * (b + c) + c * (c + a)) ≥ 9 / 2 := by
      rw [ge_iff_le]
      rw [le_div_iff (by positivity)]
      nlinarith
    exact h₁₀₃
  
  -- Combine everything to get the final result
  have h₁₁ : (a / Real.sqrt (a + b) + b / Real.sqrt (b + c) + c / Real.sqrt (c + a))^2 ≥ 9 / 2 := by
    calc
      (a / Real.sqrt (a + b) + b / Real.sqrt (b + c) + c / Real.sqrt (c + a))^2 ≥
        (a + b + c)^2 / (a * (a + b) + b * (b + c) + c * (c + a)) := by
        -- From h₉ and h₁₀
        have h₁₁₁ : (a / Real.sqrt (a + b) + b / Real.sqrt (b + c) + c / Real.sqrt (c + a))^2 * 
          (a * (a + b) + b * (b + c) + c * (c + a)) ≥ (a + b + c)^2 := h₉
        have h₁₁₂ : 0 < a * (a + b) + b * (b + c) + c * (c + a) := by
          nlinarith [mul_pos h₀.1 h₀.2.1, mul_pos h₀.2.1 h₀.2.2, mul_pos h₀.2.2 h₀.1]
        have h₁₁₃ : (a / Real.sqrt (a + b) + b / Real.sqrt (b + c) + c / Real.sqrt (c + a))^2 ≥
          (a + b + c)^2 / (a * (a + b) + b * (b + c) + c * (c + a)) := by
          rw [ge_iff_le]
          rw [div_le_iff (by positivity)]
          nlinarith
        exact h₁₁₃
      _ ≥ 9 / 2 := h₁₀
  
  -- Take square roots to get the final inequality
  have h₁₂ : a / Real.sqrt (a + b) + b / Real.sqrt (b + c) + c / Real.sqrt (c + a) ≥ 3 / Real.sqrt 2 := by
    have h₁₂₁ : 0 ≤ a / Real.sqrt (a + b) + b / Real.sqrt (b + c) + c / Real.sqrt (c + a) := by positivity
    have h₁₂₂ : (a / Real.sqrt (a + b) + b / Real.sqrt (b + c) + c / Real.sqrt (c + a))^2 ≥ 9 / 2 := h₁₁
    have h₁₂₃ : (3 / Real.sqrt 2)^2 = 9 / 2 := by
